simple.meaning: תִּמָּהוֹן (timmâhôwn) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “consternation.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 28:28. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תִּמָּהוֹן (H8541) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: תִּמָּהוֹן (timmâhôwn) / H8541 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:28, Zechariah 12:4 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H8541. timmahon תִּמָּהוֺן noun [masculine] bewilderment ; — absolute ׳ת Zech 12:4 ; construct תִּמְהוֺן Deut 28:28 ; — bewilderment, slupefaction ; ׳ת לֵבָב 28:28 , of those infatuated (see Dr.); ׳ת alone of bewildered horses Zech 12:4 .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will strike every horse with terror, and his rider with madness; and I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.
